agent_test_copy_check.name: agent_test_copy_check
agent_test_copy_check.value: not "agent"."test_copy" or ("agent"."kind" = 'client' and "agent"."template_id" is not null)

billing_statement_counts_check.name: billing_statement_counts_check
billing_statement_counts_check.value: "billing_statement"."credits_used" >= 0 and "billing_statement"."credits_included" >= 0 and "billing_statement"."extra_credits" >= 0 and "billing_statement"."credit_price" >= 0 and "billing_statement"."days_in_month" between 28 and 31

contact_reachable_check.name: contact_reachable_check
contact_reachable_check.value: "contact"."phone" is not null or "contact"."whatsapp" is not null or "contact"."email" is not null

inbox_item_undelivered_idx.name: inbox_item_undelivered_idx
inbox_item_undelivered_idx.where: "inbox_item"."status" = 'resolved' and "inbox_item"."run_id" is not null and "inbox_item"."run_received_at" is null

knowledge_chunk_source_ids_check.name: knowledge_chunk_source_ids_check
knowledge_chunk_source_ids_check.value: ("knowledge_chunk"."source_type" = 'entry' and "knowledge_chunk"."entry_id" is not null and "knowledge_chunk"."entry_version_id" is not null and "knowledge_chunk"."document_id" is null) or ("knowledge_chunk"."source_type" = 'document' and "knowledge_chunk"."document_id" is not null and "knowledge_chunk"."entry_id" is null)
